crossRefs.note: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.
If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not…

translations.web: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
translations.bsb: Like a slug that dissolves in its slime, like a woman’s stillborn child, may they never see the sun.
translations.kjv: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
translations.asv: Let them be as a snail which melteth and passeth away, Like the untimely birth of a woman, that hath not seen the sun.
